messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finledger.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Console + API onboarding for FinLedger (week of Jul 20)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking this — we’d like to schedule a combined console walkthrough + API enablement session for FinLedger during the week of July 20. High-level goals:
- Console walkthrough for product and admin flows (30-40m)
- API integration demo + live lab (40-50m)
- Q&A and next steps (20-30m)

Attendees: Priya Shah (PM), myself (CTO), and two backend engineers (names TBD).
We’re based in Pacific time (PDT). Preferred windows: mornings between 9:00-12:30 PT or afternoons 14:00-16:00 PT.

I attached a network diagram and our initial access requirements. Also: we’d like to confirm whether you can provide a temporary sandbox and credentials a few days prior.

Is Jul 21 or Jul 22 workable? If neither, we can be flexible.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Ellis | CTO, FinLedger
[Attachment: network-diagram.png (image/png)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Console + API onboarding for FinLedger (week of Jul 20)

Hi Tom,

Appreciate the context and the diagram — that helps. We can absolutely run a combined session. Two options that work for our enablement team:

- Tue, Jul 21, 10:00 - 11:00 PT (compact 60m: 30m console / 25m API demo / 5m next steps)
- Wed, Jul 22, 13:00 - 14:30 PT (90m: 40m console / 40m lab / 10m Q&A)

If you expect the API integration to require hands-on work from your engineers during the live lab, I recommend the 90m slot. We can split the session so Marissa leads the console walkthrough and Dev leads the API live lab.

Before the session we will:
- Share a short prework checklist and sandbox instructions (ETA: by end of day today)
- Provision a time-limited sandbox and test API key (we need your list of attendees' emails)

Can you confirm preferred slot and the attendee emails?

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Customer Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
